commitResults.messageBody:
Task state and storage names are unclear, and Task fields expose mutable implementation details.

Rename Athena's task storage fields for clarity and make Task fields private,
keeping the description immutable while preserving task status behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate project coding and Git standards
commitResults.messageBody:
Project guidance needs to enforce the SE-EDU coding and Git conventions for future work.

Require agents to follow the project-specific Java and Git standards while
preserving the starter template's default-package layout.

Java contributions need a reusable project-specific reference for the SE-EDU coding conventions.

Add the skill and its interface metadata so future Java work applies the
required naming, layout, encapsulation, and documentation rules.

Commit and branch conventions need a reusable project-specific reference.

Add the skill and interface metadata so future commits use clear imperative
subjects, useful bodies, and meaningful branch names.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Deadline, Event and Todo classes

commitResults.messageBody: Store only the Todo description instead of the full command line, and require an exact Todo command prefix so unrelated inputs are not classified as Todos.
Parse only valid Deadline commands, remove debug output, and report malformed input without corrupting the task count.
Keep each Event's times independently, validate the required /from and /to syntax, and reject malformed commands without corrupting the task list.

The task list size was encoded as an unexplained literal in the array declaration. Replace it with MAX_TASKS so the capacity is self-documenting and can be changed from one clearly named definition without altering runtime behavior.

Athena kept its task array and task count in static mutable fields, coupling all execution to one global session and making the application harder to test or reuse. Store session data in an Athena instance and make output operations instance-based so each session owns its state without changing the command-line behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate command dispatch from input parsing
commitResults.messageBody: The input parser handled reading input, recognizing commands, checking capacity, and mutating tasks in one method. Extract command dispatch into handleCommand so each method has one clear responsibility while preserving the existing command-line behavior.

Todo is a public task type whose purpose and construction were not documented. Add concise Javadocs so readers can understand that it represents tasks without an associated date or time without inspecting the implementation.

The main loop called nextLine without checking whether another input line existed, so a redirected or closed input stream could terminate Athena with an exception. Check hasNextLine before parsing each command so the program exits cleanly at end of input while retaining the existing farewell behavior.

The task-addition branch relied on an unbraced if statement even though its body spans multiple lines. Add braces to make the control flow explicit and prevent future edits from accidentally changing which statements are conditional.

commitResults.messageTitle: Normalize commands with a fixed locale
commitResults.messageBody: Command dispatch converted the same input line to lowercase separately for each branch, using the default locale. Normalize once with Locale.ROOT so command recognition is consistent across environments and avoids repeated work.

Several comments claimed that input was echoed or repeated the operation performed by the next statement. Remove these inaccurate and redundant comments so the source communicates intent through behavior and retains only documentation that adds context.
